crossRefs.note: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the…
She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

translations.web: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
translations.bsb: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
translations.kjv: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
translations.asv: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.
